pairs: Locutusque est Dominus ad Moysen,
And the Lord spoke to Moses,
dicens:
saying:
Loquere filiis Israël,
Speak to the sons of Israel,
et dices ad eos:
and you shall say to them:
Hæ sunt feriæ Domini,
These are the feasts of the Lord,
quas vocabitis sanctas.
which you shall call holy.
Sex diebus facietis opus:
For six days you shall do work;
dies septimus,
the seventh day,
quia sabbati requies est,
because it is the rest of the Sabbath,
vocabitur sanctus:
shall be called holy.
omne opus non facietis in eo:
You shall do no work on that day;
sabbatum Domini est in cunctis habitationibus vestris.
it is the Sabbath of the Lord in all your dwelling places.
Hæ sunt ergo feriæ Domini sanctæ,
Therefore, these are the feasts of the Lord,
quas celebrare debetis temporibus suis.
which you must celebrate in their times.
Mense primo,
The first month,
quartadecima die mensis ad vesperum,
the fourteenth day of the month, at evening,
Phase Domini est:
is the Passover of the Lord.
et quintadecima die mensis hujus, solemnitas azymorum Domini est.
And the fifteenth day of this month is the solemnity of the unleavened bread of the Lord.
Septem diebus azyma comedetis.
For seven days shall you eat unleavened bread.
Dies primus erit vobis celeberrimus,
The first day shall be greatly honored
sanctusque:
and holy to you;
omne opus servile non facietis in eo,
you shall do no servile work in it.
sed offeretis sacrificium in igne Domino septem diebus.
But you shall offer a sacrifice with fire, for seven days, to the Lord.
Dies autem septimus erit celebrior et sanctior:
Then the seventh day shall be more honored and more holy;
nullumque servile opus facietis in eo.
and you shall do no servile work in it.
Locutusque est Dominus ad Moysen,
And the Lord spoke to Moses,
dicens:
saying:
Loquere filiis Israël,
Speak to the sons of Israel,
et dices ad eos:
and you shall say to them:
Cum ingressi fueritis terram, quam ego dabo vobis,
When you will have entered into the land which I will give to you,
et messueritis segetem,
and you will have harvested your grain fields,
feretis manipulos spicarum,
you shall carry the sheaves of grain,
primitias messis vestræ,
the first-fruits of your harvest,
ad sacerdotem:
to the priest.
qui elevabit fasciculum coram Domino,
He shall lift up a sheaf before the Lord,
ut acceptabile sit pro vobis,
on the day after the Sabbath,
altero die sabbati,
so that it may be acceptable for you,
et sanctificabit illum.
and he shall sanctify it.
Atque in eodem die quo manipulus consecratur,
And on the same day that the sheaf is consecrated,
cædetur agnus immaculatus anniculus in holocaustum Domini.
a one-year-old immaculate lamb shall be slain as a holocaust of the Lord.
Et libamenta offerentur cum eo,
And the libations shall be offered with it:
duæ decimæ similæ conspersæ oleo in incensum Domini, odoremque suavissimum:
two-tenths of fine wheat flour sprinkled with oil, as an incense and a most sweet odor for the Lord;
liba quoque vini,
likewise, libations of wine,
quarta pars hin.
the fourth part of a hin.
Panem,
Bread,
et polentam,
and parched grain,
et pultes non comedetis ex segete,
and boiled grain,
usque ad diem qua offeretis ex ea Deo vestro.
you shall not eat from the grain field,
Præceptum est sempiternum in generationibus,
until the day when you shall offer from it to your God.
cunctisque habitaculis vestris.
It is an everlasting precept in your generations and in all of your dwelling places.
Numerabitis ergo ab altero die sabbati,
Therefore, you shall number from the day after the Sabbath,
in quo obtulistis manipulum primitiarum, septem hebdomadas plenas,
in which you offered a sheaf of the first-fruits, seven full weeks,
usque ad alteram diem expletionis hebdomadæ septimæ,
all the way to the day after the completion of the seventh week,
id est,
that is,
quinquaginta dies:
fifty days,
et sic offeretis sacrificium novum Domino
and then you shall offer a new sacrifice to the Lord,
ex omnibus habitaculis vestris,
from all of your dwelling places:
panes primitiarum duos de duabus decimis similæ fermentatæ,
two loaves from the first-fruits, from two-tenths of leavened fine wheat flour,
quos coquetis in primitias Domini.
which you shall bake as the first-fruits of the Lord.
Offeretisque cum panibus septem agnos immaculatos anniculos,
And you shall offer with the bread: seven immaculate one-year-old lambs,
et vitulum de armento unum,
and one calf from the herd,
et arietes duos,
and two rams,
et erunt in holocaustum cum libamentis suis,
and these shall be a holocaust, with their libations,
in odorem suavissimum Domini.
as a most sweet odor to the Lord.
Facietis et hircum pro peccato,
You shall also offer a he-goat for sin,
duosque agnos anniculos hostias pacificorum.
and two one-year-old lambs as victims of peace offerings.
Cumque elevaverit eos sacerdos cum panibus primitiarum coram Domino,
And when the priest has lifted them up with the loaves of the first-fruits, in the sight of the Lord,
cedent in usum ejus.
they shall fall to his use.
Et vocabitis hunc diem celeberrimum,
And you shall call this day most honored
atque sanctissimum:
and most holy;
omne opus servile non facietis in eo.
you shall do no servile work in it.
Legitimum sempiternum erit in cunctis habitaculis,
It shall be an everlasting ordinance in all your dwelling places
et generationibus vestris.
and generations.
Postquam autem messueritis segetem terræ vestræ,
And when you will have harvested the grain fields of your land,
nec secabitis eam usque ad solum,
you shall not cut it down all the way to the ground;
nec remanentes spicas colligetis:
neither shall you gather the remnants of the ears of grain,
sed pauperibus et peregrinis dimittetis eas.
but you shall leave these for paupers and strangers.
Ego sum Dominus Deus vester.
I am the Lord your God.
Locutusque est Dominus ad Moysen,
And the Lord spoke to Moses,
dicens:
saying:
Loquere filiis Israël:
Say to the sons of Israel:
Mense septimo,
The seventh month,
prima die mensis,
the first day of the month,
erit vobis sabbatum,
shall be a Sabbath for you,
memoriale,
a memorial,
clangentibus tubis,
with the sounding of trumpets,
et vocabitur sanctum:
and it shall be called holy.
omne opus servile non facietis in eo,
You shall do no servile work in it,
et offeretis holocaustum Domino.
and you shall offer a holocaust to the Lord.
Locutusque est Dominus ad Moysen,
And the Lord spoke to Moses,
dicens:
saying:
Decimo die mensis hujus septimi,
The tenth day of this seventh month shall be the day of atonement;
dies expiationum erit celeberrimus,
it shall be most honored,
et vocabitur sanctus:
and it shall be called holy.
affligetisque animas vestras in eo,
And you shall afflict your souls on that day,
et offeretis holocaustum Domino.
and you shall offer a holocaust to the Lord.
Omne opus servile non facietis in tempore diei hujus:
You shall do no servile work in the time of this day;
quia dies propitiationis est,
for it is a day of propitiation,
ut propitietur vobis Dominus Deus vester.
so that the Lord your God may be merciful to you.
Omnis anima, quæ afflicta non fuerit die hac, peribit de populis suis:
Every soul that has not been afflicted on this day shall perish from his people,
et quæ operis quippiam fecerit,
and anyone who will have done work,
delebo eam de populo suo.
I shall wipe him away from his people.
Nihil ergo operis facietis in eo:
Therefore,
legitimum sempiternum erit vobis in cunctis generationibus,
you shall do no work on that day.
et habitationibus vestris.
This shall be an everlasting ordinance for you in all your generations and dwelling places.
Sabbatum requietionis est,
It is a Sabbath of rest,
et affligetis animas vestras die nono mensis:
and you shall afflict your souls beginning on the ninth day of the month:
a vespera usque ad vesperam celebrabitis sabbata vestra.
from evening until evening you shall celebrate your Sabbaths.
Et locutus est Dominus ad Moysen,
And the Lord spoke to Moses,
dicens:
saying:
Loquere filiis Israël:
Say to the sons of Israel:
A quintodecimo die mensis hujus septimi,
From the fifteenth day of this seventh month,
erunt feriæ tabernaculorum septem diebus Domino.
there shall be the Feast of Tabernacles: seven days for the Lord.
Dies primus vocabitur celeberrimus atque sanctissimus:
The first day shall be called most honored and most holy;
omne opus servile non facietis in eo.
you shall do no servile work in it.
Et septem diebus offeretis holocausta Domino.
And for seven days you shall offer holocausts to the Lord.
Dies quoque octavus erit celeberrimus,
Likewise,
atque sanctissimus,
the eighth day shall be most honored and most holy,
et offeretis holocaustum Domino:
and you shall offer holocausts to the Lord.
est enim cœtus atque collectæ:
For it is the day of assembly and gathering.
omne opus servile non facietis in eo.
You shall do no servile work in it.
Hæ sunt feriæ Domini,
These are the feasts of the Lord,
quas vocabitis celeberrimas atque sanctissimas,
which you shall call most honored and most holy,
offeretisque in eis oblationes Domino,
and in them you shall offer oblations to the Lord:
holocausta et libamenta juxta ritum uniuscujusque diei:
holocausts and libations according to the rite of each particular day,
exceptis sabbatis Domini,
aside from the Sabbaths of the Lord,
donisque vestris,
and your donations,
et quæ offeretis ex voto,
and that which you offer by a vow,
vel quæ sponte tribuetis Domino.
or which you give to the Lord spontaneously.
A quintodecimo ergo die mensis septimi,
Therefore,
quando congregaveritis omnes fructus terræ vestræ,
from the fifteenth day of the seventh month,
celebrabitis ferias Domini septem diebus:
when you will have gathered together all the fruits of your land,
die primo
you shall celebrate the feast of the Lord for seven days.
et die octavo erit sabbatum,
The first day and the eighth day shall be a Sabbath,
id est,
that is,
requies.
a day of rest.
Sumetisque vobis die primo fructus arboris pulcherrimæ,
And you shall take for yourselves, on the first day, the fruits of the most beautiful tree,
spatulasque palmarum,
and branches of palm trees,
et ramos ligni densarum frondium,
and branches of trees with thick foliage,
et salices de torrente,
and willows from the torrent.
et lætabimini coram Domino Deo vestro.
And you shall rejoice in the sight of the Lord your God.
Celebrabitisque solemnitatem ejus septem diebus per annum:
And you shall celebrate its solemnity for seven days each year.
legitimum sempiternum erit in generationibus vestris.
This shall be an everlasting ordinance in your generations.
Mense septimo festa celebrabitis,
In the seventh month, you shall celebrate the feast,
et habitabitis in umbraculis septem diebus:
and you shall live under shelters for seven days.
omnis, qui de genere est Israël, manebit in tabernaculis,
All who are of the family of Israel shall dwell in tabernacles,
ut discant posteri vestri quod in tabernaculis habitare fecerim filios Israël,
so that your posterity may learn that I caused the sons of Israel to live in tabernacles,
cum educerem eos de terra Ægypti.
when I led them away from the land of Egypt.
Ego Dominus Deus vester.
I am the Lord your God.
Locutusque est Moyses super solemnitatibus Domini ad filios Israël.
And Moses spoke about the solemnities of the Lord to the sons of Israel.
